Requisitos.trecho:
WHO CAN APPLY

Any organisation and professional working in the performing arts, and legally based in one of the Creative Europe Countries (27 EU member states plus 14 non-EU Participating Countries).

PARTNERSHIP REQUIREMENTS

Proposals are submitted by partnerships. Each partnership must consist of a minimum of three partners from a minimum of three Creative Europe countries. Each proposal must include at least one performing arts work (excluding live music and opera) to be presented in a minimum of three different Creative Europe countries.

Destinação.trecho: Perform Europe is a funding scheme offering EUR 1.4 million for performing arts collaborations across all 41 Creative Europe countries.
